title: CodeBlock
description: A read-only block of preformatted text (logs, payloads, config) in a named, keyboard-focusable scroll region.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the scrollable code region (the native `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` attributes also work)

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wraps long lines (pre-wrap) instead of scrolling horizontally

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height before the block scrolls (numbers are pixels)

props.name: tabIndex
props.description: Tab order of the region; it is focusable by default so keyboard users can scroll it

props.name: copyable
props.description: Shows a copy button in the top-right corner that writes the text to the clipboard; its label switches to "Copied" / "Copy failed" for about two seconds and the result is announced through a polite live region. When set, the <pre> is wrapped in a <div> (see the interface description)

props.name: language
props.description: Language of the code: highlights its syntax and sets `class="language-<x>"` / `data-language` on the <code>. Supported: javascript (js, mjs, cjs), typescript (ts), jsx, tsx, json (jsonc, json5), css (scss, less), html (xml, svg, vue), bash (sh, shell, zsh, console), python (py), yaml (yml), sql, diff, markdown (md); other names render plain text. `"auto"` detects the language from the text (`detectCodeLanguage` of minerva-design/core, "plain" when unsure): the class, `data-language` and the label show the detected name. Without it the text is not highlighted

props.name: highlight
props.description: Highlights the syntax of `language` (false: plain text, the language is still set on the <code> and shown by `showLanguage`)

props.name: showLineNumbers
props.description: Numbers the lines in a gutter (hidden from assistive technology, not part of the copied or selected text)

props.name: showLanguage
props.description: Shows the `language` as a small label in the top-right corner (e.g. "JSON"); the <pre> is then wrapped in a <div> like with `copyable`

props.name: marks
props.description: Character ranges to mark (saved highlights, annotations, search hits), rendered as <mark> elements over the syntax highlighting (the token colors are kept; the copied text stays the raw code). `start` / `end` are UTF-16 offsets into the code string (`children`), clamped to it; empty ranges are ignored. Marks may cross tokens and lines (with `showLineNumbers` a mark is cut at each line break). Where marks overlap, the later one in the array wins (its color, class, title and click); the earlier one is cut around it. Each element gets `data-mark-id` (the mark's `id`) and the mark's `className` / `title`; `color` is a theme color name (a translucent tint) or any CSS color (default: translucent yellow, `--code-block-mark-bg`). To create one from the user's selection, see `getCodeSelectionRange` of `minerva-design/core`

events.name: onCopied
events.description: Called with the copied text after the copy button wrote it to the clipboard (not on failure). The counterpart of the `minerva-copy` event of `<minerva-code-block>` (`detail.text`, with `detail.success`); named `onCopied` so it does not replace the native `onCopy` clipboard event handler, which still goes to the element

events.name: onMarkClick
events.typeText: ((mark: CodeMark, event: MouseEvent<HTMLElement, MouseEvent>) => void) | undefined
events.description: Called when a mark is clicked (not at the end of a text selection drag), with the mark object of `marks` (the topmost one where marks overlap). Marks are not focusable: offer a keyboard path to the same action (a list of the highlights, for example)

CodeBlockProps.description: DOM placement: without `copyable` / `showLanguage` the root is the <pre> region and it receives `className`, `style`, `ref` and every native attribute. With `copyable` or a shown language label the <pre> is wrapped in a positioned <div> (the copy button and the label cannot live inside <pre>); `className`, `style` (including the `maxHeight` cap) and native attributes then go to that outermost <div>, while `ref`, `tabIndex`, `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby` stay on the <pre> region.

examples.title: Automatic language
examples.description: For code whose language is unknown (e.g. an EPUB <pre> without a class), language="auto" detects it from the text with a fast heuristic over its first 4 KB, then highlights it and labels the detected language; when unsure it stays "plain". Marks keep working. detectCodeLanguage of minerva-design/core runs the same detection on its own.

examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Text is rendered verbatim and long lines wrap by default; language="json" highlights the syntax.

examples.title: Copy button
examples.description: copyable adds a copy button in the top-right corner; the result ("Copied" / "Copy failed") is shown on the button and announced to screen readers. onCopied receives the copied text after a successful copy.

examples.title: Languages
examples.description: language picks the grammar: JavaScript / TypeScript (JSX, TSX), JSON, CSS, HTML, Bash, Python, YAML, SQL, diff and Markdown (common aliases such as ts, sh, py, yml, md work). showLanguage adds a small label; other languages render plain text.

examples.title: Line numbers
examples.description: showLineNumbers numbers the lines in a gutter hidden from screen readers; the numbers are not selected or copied with the code.

examples.title: Marks (saved highlights)
examples.description: marks lays character ranges over the syntax colors (offsets into the code; overlapping marks: the later one wins). getCodeSelectionRange of minerva-design/core turns the user's selection into offsets to save; onMarkClick reports the clicked mark (here: removes it). Copy still copies the raw code.

examples.title: Scrolling logs
examples.description: wrap={false} keeps lines intact and scrolls horizontally; maxHeight bounds the block.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: The text content is rendered verbatim (escape < in markup); language highlights the syntax and show-language shows a label. Each block is a named, focusable region.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: language picks the grammar (ts, css, html, bash, python, diff…); show-language adds a small label. The code property holds the text, never parsed as HTML.

auto-language.title: Automatic language
auto-language.description: language="auto" detects the language of unlabelled code from its text (detectCodeLanguage of minerva-design/core; "plain" when unsure); show-language, class and data-language show the detected one.

line-numbers.title: Line numbers
line-numbers.description: show-line-numbers numbers the lines in a gutter hidden from screen readers; copy still copies the raw text.

copy.title: Copy to clipboard
copy.description: The code property holds the text; copyable adds a copy button, copy() copies from outside and minerva-copy reports the result.

overflow.title: Long lines and height
overflow.description: no-wrap scrolls long lines horizontally and max-height caps the block; the region scrolls with the keyboard too.

marks.title: Marks (saved highlights)
marks.description: marks lays character ranges over the syntax colors; getSelectionRange() maps the user's selection to offsets and minerva-mark-click reports the clicked mark (here: removes it).

props.code: Source text (default: the element's text content).
props.language: Language of the code: highlights its syntax and sets class="language-<x>" / data-language on the <code>. "auto" detects it from the text (detectCodeLanguage; "plain" when unsure).
props.noHighlight: Keeps the code plain despite language (the React library's highlight={false}).
props.noWrap: Scrolls long lines horizontally instead of wrapping them (the React library's wrap={false}).
props.showLineNumbers: Numbers the lines in a gutter (aria-hidden, not part of the copied text).
props.showLanguage: Shows the language as a small label in the top-right corner (e.g. "JSON").
props.marks: Character ranges to mark ({ start, end, color?, className?, id?, title? }, UTF-16 offsets into the text): the property or a JSON array attribute. The later of overlapping marks wins.
props.clickableMarks: Gives the marks a click affordance (pointer cursor, hover underline); set it when listening to minerva-mark-click.

events.minerva-copy: The copy button or copy() was used (detail: { text, success }; text is the copied text, React's onCopied receives it on success).
events.minerva-mark-click: A mark was clicked, not at the end of a selection drag (detail: { mark, originalEvent }; React's onMarkClick).

cssVars.--icon-button-color: Icon color of the copy button.
cssVars.--icon-button-hover-bg: Background of the copy button on hover.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-color: Icon color of a pressed copy button.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-bg: Background of a pressed copy button.
cssVars.--icon-button-size: Width and height of the copy button.
cssVars.--icon-button-icon-size: Font size of the copy icon.
cssVars.--icon-button-radius: Corner radius of the copy button.

methods.copy: Copies the text to the clipboard; resolves with whether it worked.
methods.getSelectionRange: Offsets in text of the user's selection inside the code ({ start, end, text }), or null; reads the selection through the shadow root.

marks.description: marks highlights character ranges with nested Text backgrounds; onMarkClick reports the pressed mark.

native.limitations: Native CodeBlock uses a maximum height of 384 density-independent pixels, corresponding to the web default of 24rem at a 16px root size. Pass copyText to connect Expo Clipboard on iOS and Android.
